# Tamil Chat - Free Online Tamil Chat Rooms & Video Calling | TamilChat

> **tamilchats.online** (https://tamilchats.online/) is Tamil Nadu's #1 free online chat platform for **Tamil Chat**. Enjoy free **Tamil chat rooms**, voice **calling**, stranger **video calling**, and anonymous messaging to connect with fellow Tamilians across Tamil Nadu and worldwide.

## Key Features

- **Public and Private Rooms**: Join group discussions in Tamil Nadu rooms or use direct one-on-one private messaging with friendly Tamils.
- **No-Download Access**: Chat and video call directly in your web browser without needing complex setups or native app downloads.
- **Global Community**: Connect with Tamilians living in Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy, Salem, Tirunelveli, Vellore) and around the world (Singapore, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Gulf NRIs, USA, UK).
- **Live Status**: Features real-time online user count, instant message delivery, and seen indicators.
- **Free 1-on-1 Video Calling**: Instant high-definition WebRTC encrypted voice and video calls with zero coins or paywalls.
- **Guest Access**: Join as a guest immediately with an anonymous display name; no password, email, or mobile number required.

## How to Join as a Guest on tamilchats.online

1. Visit [tamilchats.online](https://tamilchats.online/) on any mobile or desktop web browser.
2. Enter your preferred nickname or display name (minimum 2 characters).
3. Click "Start Chatting" to immediately enter live Tamil public chat rooms or start 1-on-1 stranger video calls with zero registration.
